Compendium

A concise collection of information about a subject or a range of subjects.

  • Knowledge
  • Vocabulary

Context

A compendium gathers material into a form that is convenient to consult. It can bring together definitions, explanations, facts, or selections from a larger body of work.

The Compendium on Aaron Schlossberg’s Universe uses short definitions as an entry point, with separate pages for context, examples, references, and connections to other ideas.

Examples

  • A field guide that summarizes local plants, habitats, and identification clues can function as a compendium.
